aarti.pad1: Victory to you, Kūṣmāṇḍā, giver of happiness to the world;
have mercy on me, great queen.
You are Piṅgalā, the wondrous Jvālāmukhī,
aarti.pad2: You have lakhs of names, each one wondrous;
many of your devotees are lost in love of you.
Your dwelling is on Mount Bhīmā;
aarti.pad3: I thirst for the sight of you;
aarti.pad4: The Mother has deep tenderness in her heart;
why would she not hear our plea?
I have made my camp at your door;
aarti.pad5: Your servant meditates on you alone;
your devotee bows his head at your door.
